description: Hotel perk rules — program-neutral rule data for the Hotel Award Radar. Config, never code. A rule here NEVER by itself licenses arithmetic: affectsArithmetic only marks that a LATER construction may cite this rule WHEN the underlying observation carries sufficient source-stated data (a source-stated full-stay total is authoritative; actual per-night point values plus a verified rule may support a construction; an average points/night alone NEVER becomes a stay total). Nothing in this phase computes anything. verification: 'source_page' = the encoded conditions were read on the official sourceUrl on verifiedAt (quotes in verificationEvidence); 'knowledge_encoded' = NOT verified online (source bot-walled) — the UI must mark these unverified and no optimizer may ever treat them as verified. Optimizer-critical conditions are MACHINE-ENCODED, never prose-only: repetition (once_per_stay | per_block = repeats every stayPattern.minNights | once_per_certificate; required on arithmetic rules, null on benefit-only), requiresCertificate {type, quantity} (matched against entitlements certificates[].key), requiredRateName (exact named rate the booking must use), constraints (source-stated: single_reservation, standard_room_only, full_points_only, weekend_stay — absence means unstated, never permission), exclusions (source-stated: free_night_certificate, award_redemption, other_free_night_offers). Where a source states a benefit singularly without addressing recurrence (Hilton 5th night, IHG card 4th night), repetition is encoded as the conservative floor once_per_stay — upgrading to per_block requires reading the program's full T&C recurrence language first.
eligibilityKeyFormat: kind:KEY where kind ∈ membership|status|card and KEY is [A-Z0-9_]+ — matched EXACTLY against config/entitlements.json; entitlement is never inferred.

rules.displayBenefit: Stay for 5, Pay for 4: redeem points for 5 consecutive nights under ONE reservation (Standard Redemption or PointSavers) and the lowest-point night is free (first such night on ties). Standard rooms only; cannot span multiple reservations, cannot be applied after check-in; Free Night Award certificates are NOT eligible.
rules.bookingChannel: Marriott direct, one confirmation number, Standard Redemption Award or PointSavers Award, standard room (not Premium Room).
rules.verificationEvidence: Bonvoy T&C §3.3.d read 2026-08-28: 'A Member who redeems Points for five consecutive nights ... using a Standard Redemption Award or PointSavers Award under one reservation ... will only need to redeem Points for four nights'; free night = 'the night with the lowest Point redemption rate within the same Award Redemption Stay'. §3.3.a.iii: Free Night Awards 'are not eligible for the Stay for 5, Pay for 4 Offer'.
rules.arithmeticNote: May only ever be applied to actual per-night point values or a source-stated total — never to an average points/night figure. The T&C states ONE free night per Award Redemption Stay (lowest-rate night), not one per 5-night block; any construction must follow that exactly.

rules.displayBenefit: Fifth night free on reward stays for Hilton Honors elites (Silver, Gold, Diamond, Diamond Reserve) when booking a standard room with 100% Points.
rules.bookingChannel: Hilton direct, standard room booked with 100% Points (not Points & Money).
rules.verificationEvidence: Official tier table read 2026-08-28: 'Fifth night free on reward stays*' — Member: not included; Silver/Gold/Diamond/Diamond Reserve: included. Footnote: '*Your fifth night is free when you book a standard room with 100% Points.'
rules.arithmeticNote: May only ever be applied to actual per-night point values or a source-stated total — never to an average points/night figure.

rules.displayBenefit: 4th Reward Night free on points stays of 4+ consecutive nights for IHG One Rewards Premier credit card holders (US Chase card).
rules.bookingChannel: IHG direct Reward Night point redemptions, same reservation and property.
rules.verificationEvidence: Chase IHG Premier perks page read 2026-08-28: 'Redeem 3 Nights, get 4th Night Free — The fourth Reward Night is free when you redeem points for any stay of four or more nights.' (Previous config sourceUrl ihg.com/onerewards/content/us/en/credit-cards now 404s and was replaced.)
rules.arithmeticNote: May only ever be applied to actual per-night point values or a source-stated total — never to an average points/night figure. Whether the benefit repeats every 4th night of a longer stay is stated only in the card's full benefit terms — resolve THAT text before constructing anything beyond the first free night.

rules.displayBenefit: InterContinental Ambassador annual Complimentary Weekend Night CERTIFICATE (one per purchase/renewal, valid 12 months): second night credited on a minimum two-night weekend stay booked on the dedicated 'Ambassador Complimentary Weekend Night' rate at InterContinental Hotels & Resorts (excluding InterContinental Alliance Resorts). Not combinable with Reward Nights or other free-night offers.
rules.bookingChannel: IHG direct on the named 'Ambassador Complimentary Weekend Night' rate ONLY — no other rate qualifies; room and tax only.
rules.verificationEvidence: Official page + Ambassador T&C read 2026-08-28: 'Upon purchase and renewal of InterContinental Ambassador status, an Ambassador Complimentary Weekend Night is awarded. Each ... is valid for 12 months from the date of issue and is redeemable in conjunction with a minimum two-night weekend stay when booking the Ambassador Complimentary Weekend Night rate ... excluding InterContinental Alliance Resorts (not valid at any other IHG hotel brands)'.
rules.arithmeticNote: This is a CERTIFICATE, not a standing perk: any construction must consume exactly one unused annual certificate (now machine-encoded in requiresCertificate), apply only on the named rate (requiredRateName), and include the Ambassador acquisition cost (USD 225 or 45,000 points per year — see the entitlement's acquisitionAlternatives).

rules.displayBenefit: Daily food and beverage credit for Hilton Honors Gold, Diamond and Diamond Reserve members (credit amount varies by property; the source states the benefit, not a universal breakfast).
rules.bookingChannel: Hilton direct / qualifying rates; per-property amounts and brand exceptions live in Hilton's details and disclaimers.
rules.verificationEvidence: Official tier table read 2026-08-28: 'Daily food and beverage credit' — Member/Silver: not included; Gold/Diamond/Diamond Reserve: included. The page no longer frames this as breakfast; the former US-credit-vs-breakfast-elsewhere split is not stated there and was dropped from this rule.
rules.arithmeticNote: Benefit only — never monetized into any price comparison. Per-property credit amounts are not encodable here and must never be guessed.

rules.displayBenefit: Elite Welcome Gift choice for Marriott Bonvoy Platinum and above — the choices (bonus points, F&B credit, amenity, or restaurant breakfast) vary by brand AND region per the Bonvoy T&C brand table; breakfast is only one possible option at select brands/resorts, NOT a universal Platinum entitlement.
rules.bookingChannel: Marriott direct / qualifying rates; exact gift options per brand and region are in the Bonvoy T&C Elite Welcome Gift table (not offered at StudioRes).
rules.verificationEvidence: Bonvoy T&C Elite Welcome Gift table read 2026-08-28: e.g. Marriott Hotels/JW/Renaissance non-resort US/CA/Europe = '1,000 Points per Stay or U.S. $10 F&B credit per Stay' (breakfast option at RESORTS only); Le Méridien/Sheraton/St. Regis/Westin etc. include 'breakfast in restaurant per night of Stay for Member +1'. The gift is a brand-by-region CHOICE matrix this schema cannot fully encode — this rule deliberately claims only the umbrella benefit.
rules.arithmeticNote: Benefit only — never monetized into any price comparison. The brand×region gift matrix is NOT encoded here; nothing may assume breakfast at a specific property from this rule.
